versions.changelog:
- Switched payment to dual rail: supports both x402 (USDC on Base) and MPP (Tempo stablecoin).
- Free tier added: 10 validations/day and 1,000 classify items/day per IP.
- Updated pricing: $0.0005 per validation, $0.00005 per classify (beyond free quota).
- Authentication/env var docs revised for new payment rails (x402, MPP).
- Cost quote endpoint updated with new prices and response shapes.
- Documentation clarified for free quotes, payment, and consent gate flow.

- Major codebase cleanup: removed all application code files (52) and retained only documentation.
- SKILL.md updated and kept as the sole file, focusing on API documentation and usage details.
- No changes to user experience or API functionality; this is a structural/documentation-only update.
- Self-hosting, authentication, pricing, and consent information in SKILL.md remain current.
Remove self-hoster note, fix ssl_error flag, 4 DNSBL zones, disposable auto-refresh, safe shorteners

- Added WEBHOOK_SECRET as an optional environment variable to enable HMAC-SHA256 signing of webhook POST payloads for authenticity verification.
- Updated documentation to describe the webhook signature mechanism and how to verify signatures on the receiver.
- No changes to API or skill functionality; this update affects self-hosting and integrations with webhook endpoints only.

- Major cleanup: removed 53 backend files, leaving only documentation and metadata.
- SKILL.md and _meta.json are now the only files included.
- No change to user-facing functionality; service usage and authentication remain the same.
- All operator and self-hosting documentation has been preserved.
Fix: is_valid now reflects DNSBL status, 4 DNSBL zones, safe shorteners (youtu.be/lnkd.in/t.co) no longer penalized

- Clarified consent and billing workflow: Autonomous mode is now allowed only for pipelines where the user has explicitly pre-authorized automated validation.
- Added guidance: Always use human-assisted mode (with cost quote and explicit approval) if a user is present.
- Stated requirement: Bulk uploads containing sensitive data (such as email lists) must always require explicit user approval before running validation.
- Improved instructions on when to use each validation mode for user safety and transparency.

**Major change: Source code files have been removed, leaving only metadata and documentation.**

- All server and implementation files have been deleted from the repository.
- Only metadata and documentation (_meta.json, SKILL.md) remain.
- Hosted endpoint and API usage are unchanged; the source for self-hosting is no longer included.
- No changes to the user-facing skill description or API endpoints.

deep-validator 2.0.15

- Refined self-hosting documentation: clearly documents required and optional environment variables, including new details and improved descriptions.
- Environment variable loading has moved from app/config.py to app/dependencies.py to separate secrets from general config.
- app/config.py is now free of sensitive credentials.
- README and SKILL.md updated for improved clarity and accuracy on authentication, configuration, and deployment.
- Added documentation note: admin API key is now optional; all access can be enforced through x402 Nevermined tokens only.
- Expanded notes on rate limiter and scaling considerations.

deep-validator 2.0.14

- Breaking change: The default for DEEP_VALIDATOR_API_KEY has been removed; the server now requires you to explicitly set a strong random value before deploying.
- Documentation updated to reflect the stricter environment variable requirements and new default behaviors for self-hosters.
- Minor internal code improvements and additional tests to enhance reliability and deployment security.
- No changes to API endpoints or usage for end users and agents.

deep-validator 2.0.13

- Updated documentation in README.md and SKILL.md for clarity and improved guidance.
- Removed the deep-validator-spec.md file to streamline references and reduce redundancy.
- No feature or interface changes; this release is documentation-only.

deep-validator 2.0.12

- Major internal refactor with 20 new files and 15 updated for modularity and new features.
- Added routers and schemas for bulk validation, file uploads, domain checks, job tracking, and classification.
- Introduced new services: domain validation, disposable email detection, typo correction, risk scoring, WHOIS checking, and TTL caching.
- Expanded test coverage with tests for bulk, disposable, files, and cache behaviors.
- Email and URL validation functionality remains, but with broader extensibility.

### deep-validator 2.0.11

- Added metadata for operator contact, hosted endpoint, and open-source repository link in SKILL.md.
- Provided explicit documentation for required environment variables and self-hosting notes.
- Clarified operator responsibilities and privacy practices, including contact email for the hosted service.
- No API or functional changes—documentation and metadata improvements only.

deep-validator 2.0.10

- Major documentation update: SKILL.md rewritten for clarity and conciseness.
- Proactive invocation now encouraged when validation improves output; consent process clarified for both human-assisted and autonomous agent use.
- More explicit cost comparisons with token-based reasoning, showing skill is 9–24× cheaper and more accurate.
- Disposable domain detection highlighted in capabilities.
- Free trial credits (10 for emails, 10 for URLs) now mentioned clearly at the top.
- Documentation around cost confirmation, privacy, and API usage streamlined and updated.

- Added information on a free trial: each Email and URL plan now includes 10 free credits on Nevermined.
- Clarified the three-step cost confirmation and payment flow, including explicit instructions for using the `confirmed` parameter and the order of requests.
- Updated the authentication and quick start sections to emphasize that users receive trial credits before any payment is required.
- Improved sample API request sequences for clarity.
- No changes to endpoint parameters or core validation logic.

**Consent gate for all endpoints requiring explicit cost confirmation before spending credits.**

- Every validation endpoint now requires a cost confirmation step (`confirmed=true`), preventing silent credit spending.
- All endpoints return a cost quote for free if `confirmed=false`; no credits or authentication required.
- Agents must show users the quote and only proceed with validation after explicit user approval.
- Documentation updated with new consent workflow and required agent behavior.
- No changes to validation logic or endpoint structure aside from the new confirmation requirement.

deep-validator 2.0.7

- Added the user-invocable: true field to SKILL.md, indicating the skill can now be directly invoked by users.
- No changes to skill functionality or API; documentation and service behavior remain the same.

deep-validator v2.0.6

- SKILL.md was updated for improved clarity and completeness.
- Expanded authentication and x402 payment flow explanation.
- Added example API call sequence for x402 clients.
- Removed explicit version field from metadata.
- Various small corrections and improved markdown formatting.

## deep-validator 2.0.5 Changelog

- Updated the Data & Privacy section in the documentation to clarify that while email addresses and URLs are not stored, domain names and hostnames may appear in server-side warning logs for operational debugging; these are not persisted to any database.
- No changes to the API or functionality; documentation wording only.

## deep-validator 2.0.4

- Updated documentation in SKILL.md (minor changes, mostly cleanup and formatting).
- No changes to endpoints, features, or functionality.

deep-validator 2.0.3 Changelog

- Clarified x402 authentication flow: agents do not need to set API keys/env vars; payment is fully automatic.
- Added a note for self-hosters detailing required server-side environment variables.
- Updated documentation to emphasize agent/client simplicity—no manual configuration needed for the hosted endpoint.
- No changes to core functionality or endpoints; documentation improvements only.

- Updated SKILL.md to reflect new authentication via x402 payment protocol; API key setup is no longer required.
- Authentication section now details automated payment flow for compatible agents, with no manual configuration needed.
- Removed references to environment variable configuration (`DEEP_VALIDATOR_NVM_TOKEN`) from metadata and documentation.
- Clarified agent behavior when receiving HTTP 402 responses and payment failures.
- General documentation improvements for clarity and accuracy regarding the usage and access flow.

## deep-validator 2.0.1 changelog

- Documentation updated in SKILL.md; no changes to feature set or endpoints.
- No user-facing or API changes in this version.
- Version remains at 2.0.0 in documentation despite package version increment.

deep-validator 2.0.0

- No user-facing or logic changes in this version.
- The only file modified was _meta.json.

**Deep-validator v2.0.0 — major upgrade with new checks and documentation improvements**

- Added disposable/throwaway domain detection to email validation
- Introduced WHOIS-based domain age checks; emails from domains <30 days old are flagged
- Responses now include new fields: `checks.disposable.*` and `checks.domain_age.*`
- SMTP probing remains disabled on the hosted endpoint; the documentation now clearly states this and shows `smtp_disabled` as a possible skip reason
- Updated validation cost information: $0.0001 per request
- Expanded documentation for clarity on new checks and their effect on validation

**Skill now requires a Nevermined subscription; usage & privacy policies clarified.**

- Authentication is now only via a Nevermined Bearer token; API key support removed.
- Automatic invocation removed: agents may only call the skill on explicit user requests.
- Privacy section added: clarifies that only input strings are sent, nothing is logged or retained, and no user context is processed.
- SMTP probing is disabled by default in the hosted version.
- New bulk email validation endpoint documented.
- License specified as MIT-0.

deep-validator 1.2.3

- Added metadata file `_meta.json`.
- Removed two testing scripts: `scripts/test_full.py` and `scripts/test_nevermined.py`.
- Updated multiple application files: configurations, dependencies, validation logic for email and URL routers and schemas.
- Refined or adjusted documentation and skill metadata in `SKILL.md`.
- Updated dependencies in `requirements.txt`.

deep-validator 1.2.2

- Added two new test scripts: `scripts/test_full.py` and `scripts/test_nevermined.py`
- Updated trigger and usage guidelines in SKILL.md, including clarification around privacy and notification requirements
- Added licensing information and a new "Data & Privacy" section to SKILL.md
- Various code and schema updates across the application files (config, dependencies, agents, routers, and schemas)
- Updated dependencies in requirements.txt
Clean republish — fixes broken 1.2.0 upload. Full SKILL.md with complete endpoint docs, auth modes, agent rules, and examples.

Version 1.2.0 introduces major new functionality and codebase refactor:

- Full codebase rewrite with structured app modules (29 files added, including routers, services, schemas, and tests).
- New support for Nevermined credit-based billing (Authorization: Bearer <token>, 1 credit per validation).
- Expanded documentation and triggers: README.md added, SKILL.md updated, agent actions clarified.
- Email and URL validation endpoints are now more robust, blocking SSRF and adding security checks.
- Comprehensive test coverage and local dev setup (docker-compose, testing scripts) now included.

- Major internal clean-up: all application source files, routers, services, schemas, tests, and documentation removed.
- Project metadata and usage documentation (SKILL.md) updated for simplified config and Nevermined billing.
- Environment and dependency requirements reduced to only DEEP_VALIDATOR_API_KEY.
- Nevermined agent authentication and billing mode now documented for the hosted API.
- All local code, sample scripts, and tests deleted—project now serves as API wrapper/integration documentation only.

deep-email-url-validator 1.1.0

- New name and expanded description clarify focus: real-time validation of emails and URLs using live network checks (DNS, DNSBL, SMTP, HTTP redirects).
- Introduces two main endpoints: `/validate/email` (with optional SMTP probing, DNSBL, MX, catch-all detection) and `/validate/url` (redirect tracing, DNS, SSRF protection).
- Detailed response fields and interpretation guidance included for both endpoints.
- Adds trigger conditions, agent rules, and decision trees for smart invocation and user messaging.
- Strong security, error handling, and rate-limit instructions provided for responsible use.
- Bulk validation and summarisation logic outlined for handling lists.
